It is also a match-3, survival horror, comedy RPG metroidvania, a combination of genres that I never thought was possible, and yet here we are with a game that looks pretty fun.

 
Read more
articles.title: Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion 3 is a survival horror, match-3 metroidvania sequel to a game that doesn't exist

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Remember Spore? I never played the original one myself, just that crappy one Spore Creatures on the DS, but I've long appreciated what Spore was trying to do from afar. There's an almost whimsical macabre feeling to it, playing god and all that, leading a creature down the path of evolution. You don't see too many games like that these days, though today's a bit of an exception given the announcement of Voidling Bound, a monster-taming/ gene splicing game from a team made up of former Skylanders devs.

 
Read more
articles.title: Ex-Skylanders devs announce Voidling Bound, a monster-taming game that looks more Spore than it does Pokemon

articles.author: Robert Anderson
articles.description:
The Elder Scrolls 4: Oblivion Remastered is out now, and PC players can grab a discount by picking up a Steam key from Fanatical, or Green Man Gaming.
 Read more
articles.title: Oblivion Remastered is available now, here's how to save 17% for PC gamers on Steam

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Righto, Diablo 4 season 8 is starting next week, and today Blizzard have dropped a whole bunch of details on it ahead of its release on April 29th, so let's see what they are! First up, there's that Belial guy who the season is named after. He's back, but his "motive is unknown", and you'll eventually be able to face off against him in a new quest which introduces a couple of new NPCs. That's all well and good, but the big thing this season is its new main mechanic, boss powers.

 
Read more
articles.title: Diablo 4 season 8 is all about becoming a boss and cosplaying characters from Berserk

articles.author: Brendan Caldwell
articles.description:
Years after it was first leaked, and following weeks of increasingly loud rumours, Bethesda have finally shown off a trailer for The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion remaster. It looks very shiny, and has a few new cogs under the hood. More importantly, it's out now.
Read more
articles.title: Bethesda release Oblivion Remastered for £50

articles.author: Brendan Caldwell
articles.description:
The closed alpha for Marathon is soon due to roll out to players who signed up, meaning Bungie's colourful futuristic servers are warming up. Sadly, we weren't invited - the alpha is only open to North Americans. But, aha, something went awry today and the game became available to play early for those on Xbox. And one quick-witted player streamed a full hour of the game before the servers clamped shut once again. 
Read more
articles.title: A streamer played an hour of Marathon early before Bungie cut him off

articles.author: Christian Wait
articles.description:
I've just picked up the Anker 24,000mAh 65W Portable Charger for $34.99 in Woot’s charging devices sale, and it's been one of the more practical purchases I've made for my Steam Deck and ROG Ally X. At half off the regular $69.99 price, it's an easy recommendation. It's powerful, compact, and actually delivers the speed these handhelds need without making a scene about it.
 Read more
articles.title: Anker 537 is the best Steam Deck power bank I've tested, and it's only $35 today

articles.author: Nic Reuben
articles.description:
At some point in their development of the most recent trilogy, someone at Id Software apparently decided that the most interesting thing about their FPS was the character of the Doom Slayer himself - an odd though not entirely disastrous decision that I'd argue is mostly responsible for the design shape of Doom Eternal. I'm a big fan, even despite this misplaced fascination with its unnecessarily fleshed out gun-numpad-with-legs. I'm hoping to be a fan of Doom: The Dark Ages too, but based on the latest trailer, I'm still trying to tell whether they've scaled the Slayer lore back or are still banking on me being enraptured to learn the millenia-long backstory to why I'm yanking a Cacodemon's eyeball out like clogged hair from shower drain.
Read more
articles.title: Doom: The Dark Ages story trailer shows off a full-scale hell invasion

articles.author: Nic Reuben
articles.description:
Ah, well thank heck for that. I thought I'd spent my weekend hunched over a screen in a goblinesque sweat-trance. No! Says Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 voice actor Andy Serkis: I was simply partaking in some vital culture; a veritable Wildean sophisticate. Film industry folks thought games were "not an art form in any stretch," Serkis told Game Watcher, "and gradually it's taken over the film industry, which could not exist without it." Take that, Roger Ebert's dead wrong dead horse of a dead body.
Read more
articles.title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33's Andy Serkis says the film industry "could not exist" without games

articles.author: Brendan Caldwell
articles.description:
The maker of cryptic block-seeding puzzler Starseed Pilgrim has announced a new game in which you are invited to do the unspeakable and "kill gameplay". The End Of Gameplay will be an exploratory 2D platformer according to the tags on its Steam page but anyone who has played the work of creator Droqen might predict those labels to prove looser than a toddler's shoelace. Enjoyers of obscure and poetic wanderings in minimalist spaces will probably be happy with the trailer below.
Read more
articles.title: Starseed Pilgrim creator's new platformer wants to "kill gameplay"

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
This week, no liveblog, for Edwin is away and the Maw is strangely passive - as delicate and pliant as the crumbling of embers in the grate. Still, there are new PC games. 


On Tuesday 22nd April 2025, get your digits into deckbuilding dream-diver Out Of Hands, commit to the bit in "match-3 survival horror comedy RPG metroidvania" Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mountain 3, platform through megacities in Steel Seed, team up to crash submarines in Darkwater, and rewarm your memories of PS1/PS2 survival horror in Post Trauma. On Wednesday 23rd April 2025, a choice of fantasy boardgames through a phone in Sunderfolk, time-travelling in pixel-clicker Old Skies, spying on passengers in Beholder Conductor, and galloping through bullets in Asura The Striker.
 
Read more
articles.title: The Maw: what's new in PC games this week?

articles.author: Oisin Kuhnke
articles.description:
Everything is expensive. Everything! Bills, food, video games, you name it. I mean, £75 for a game where you drive around as an Italian plumber? Not entirely convinced by this one, Mr. Bowser. I could get into the weeds of why all of this is happening (none of it for being particularly good reasons), but I won't because I bring word of something actually getting less expensive. Shock horror, I know, and yet here are Rockfish Games announcing that Everspace 2's upcoming Wrath of the Ancients DLC will be a bit cheaper when it launches.
 
Read more
articles.title: As literally everything gets more and more expensive, Everspace 2's devs say screw it, let's make our upcoming DLC cheaper

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Týden v KDE nejen přesouvání souborů bez ptaní či monitoring GPU, Nvidia CUDA končí s Maxwell / Pascal / Volta, Wine 10.7 opravuje nejen WinAmp.
articles.title: Konec vydávání KDE Plasma LTS, GNOME zkouší nový jazyk pro definici UI

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Oprava výkonnostní regrese v jádru 6.15 u CPU AMD, změna podpory souborových systémů HFS/HFS+, aktualizace ovladačů pro platformu x86, další vylepšení ovladače Intel Xe pro Linux 6.16.
articles.title: Novinky v jádře: konec padání na 32bitových x86 s více RAM, PCI Express pro Apple M2 Pro

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: Dnešní příspěvek bude o portaci hry Brány Skeldalu, která vyšla v roce 1998. To že to nebyla snadná cesta už dokazuje to, že tento článek vznikl. Pokusím se vypíchnout hlavně různé nástrahy, které si vynutily speciální zacházení
articles.title: Portuji 27 let starou hru napsanou v C

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Dušan Kreheľ)
articles.description: V tomto krátkom seriáli sa naučíme si v programe Fontforge vytvárať vlastné vektorové písmo. V dnešnom prvom diele sa pozrieme na celkový proces vytvorenia fontu a nabudúce sa povenujeme tvorbe glyfov.
articles.title: Fontforge: fonty, glyfy a vektorová grafika

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jiří Sluka)
articles.description: Pravidelná sonda do světa software. Podíváme se na nástroj pro správu virtuálních strojů v cloudu, budeme procházet objemné log soubory a nakonec vyzkoušíme pomocníka pro přepínání mezi kubeconfigy.
articles.title: Softwarová sklizeň (30. 4. 2025): spravujte své virtuální servery

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: APT (Advanced Package Tool) je balíčkovací systém používaný zejména v Debianu a Ubuntu. Vývojáři představili třetí generaci, která má lepší řešení závislostí a nové řešení pro kontrolu elektronických podpisů.
articles.title: Balíčkovací systém APT 3.0: lepší rozhraní a nový řešitel závislostí

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Pavel Tišnovský)
articles.description: Začneme se zabývat dalším problémem, který je poměrně dobře řešitelný s využitím knihovny PyTorch. Jedná se o rozpoznávání a klasifikaci rastrových obrázků. Řešení (většinou) spočívá ve využití konvolučních neuronových sítí.
articles.title: PyTorch: problematika rozpoznávání a klasifikace obrázků

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Kopřiva)
articles.description: V dnešním díle Postřehů se společně podíváme na schválení novely zákona o kybernetické bezpečnosti, novou verzi rámce MITRE ATT&CK nebo pokračující podporu cookies třetích stran v Chromu.
articles.title: Postřehy z bezpečnosti: nový zákon o kybernetické bezpečnosti prošel Poslaneckou sněmovnou

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Filip Zatloukal)
articles.description: Vývojářské obrazy Ubuntu 24.04 jsou nyní k dispozici pro nový jednodeskový počítač OrangePi RV2 RISC-V. Tým Nitrux provádí úklid, odstraňuje staré nástroje pro správu balíčků a zavádí nové.
articles.title: Ubuntu na OrangePi RV2, Nitrux mění správce balíčků

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: V tomto příspěvku se vrátím ke korutinám, shrnu v jakém stavu je C++ 5 let po zavedení do normy a jaké osobní zkušenosti s korutinami mám.
articles.title: Zamyšlení se nad korutinami v C++20

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: rennergy)
articles.description: Oregonská státní univerzita po nedávných změnách ve svém financování plánuje přerušit další financování své Open Source Lab (OSUOSL), významné nejen pro Gentoo Linux. Pokud se do 14. května 2025 nepodaří sehnat 250 000 dolarů na další provoz ze soukromých zdrojů, bude její provoz letos ukončen.
articles.title: Oregon State University Open Source Lab v ohrožení, problém se dotýká také Gentoo

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Databáze Redis před rokem změnila licenci na duální Redis Source Available License (RSALv2) a Server Side Public License (SSPLv1). Tyto licence již nebyly považovány za svobodné. Kvůli změně licence se objevily forky například Valkey (BSD3) a Redict (LGPL-3.0).
articles.title: Redis 8.0 opět se svobodnou licencí

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Včera Joy Chik a Vasu Jakkal z Microsoftu uvedli, že nové účty u Microsoftu budou ve výchozím stavu bez hesla a budou používat Passkey. Uživatelé stávajících účtů mohou v nastavení své heslo smazat.
articles.title: Microsoft bude mít nové účty bez hesla

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Vývojář Mediateku Qun-Wei Lin ve středu navrhl pro jádro nový démon kcompressd. V současnosti kswapd obsluhuje zároveň swap a zároveň kompresi zswap a zram. V případě nedostatku paměti pak spolu tyto dvě úlohy mohou kolidovat a zhoršovat výkon.
articles.title: Mediatek navrhuje pro jádro kcompressd, zlepšuje situaci při velkém tlaku na paměť

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: LibreSSL 4.1 zavádí nové implementace SHA-1, SHA-256 a SHA-512 pro x86_64 s moderními procesory AMD a Intel. Tyto nové implementace využívají instrukce SHA-NI, pokud jsou v procesoru k dispozici.
articles.title: LibreSSL 4.1 nabízí rychlejší implementaci algoritmu SHA na moderních procesorech

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: Pojďte s námi prozkoumat tajuplný svět hackingu a množství jeho jednotlivých zákoutí. Průvodcem na této cestě vám bude zkušený etický hacker s mnohaletou praxí, který se s vámi podělí o své zkušenosti. Připravili jsme pro vás šestidenní online kurz Hacking v praxi, který je z velké části placený úřadem práce. Přihlásit se ale musíte do neděle 4. května.
articles.title: Šestidenní online kurz Hacking v praxi dotovaný úřadem práce

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: PyXL je počítačový procesor, který je speciálně navržen pro provádění kódu v jazyce Python. Obvykle je to tak, že na procesoru běží interpret jazyka. Tady je ovšem interpretrem přímo samotný křemík procesoru PyXL. Výsledkem je velmi rychlý běh programu, což se hodí u aplikací, u kterých je důležité časování.
articles.title: PyXL je procesor, na kterém přímo běží Python

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Desky Raspberry Pi používají kombinaci součástek pro povrchovou montáž (SMD) a průchozích vývodů. SMD umožňují připojit k deskám mnohem více drobných součástek pomocí jejich drobných pinů, plochých kontaktů, pájecích kuliček nebo jiných spojů.
articles.title: Raspberry Pi snížilo počty reklamací na polovinu díky změně pájení

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL) 2 podporuje instalaci vlastních distribucí již od svých počátků a existovaly komunitní projekty, které uživatelům nabízely instalaci distribuce Arch Linux – například ArchWSL. Francouzský vývojář Robin Candau nyní informoval, že se Arch dostal do oficiální nabídky WSL.
articles.title: Windows Subsystem for Linux nabízí oficiálně také instalací Arch Linuxu

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Rada pro plánování IT v Německu se zavázala přejít na formát dokumentů Open Document Format (ODF). To je plně standardizovaný formát, který je zároveň výchozím formátem používaném v kancelářském balíku LibreOffice. Německá Rada pro plánování IT je sedmnáctičlenný výbor složený ze zástupců německé federální vlády a vlád jednotlivých spolkových zemí.
articles.title: Němci chtějí od roku 2027 používat otevřené standardy pro výměnu dokumentů

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Ben Skeggs je v Nvidii, kam přešel z Red Hatu, přibližně rok a zdá se, že i nadále se s ním věcí hýbou trošku k lepšímu, tedy pro uživatele grafických karet s GPU NVidia. Nyní do jádra, konkrétně ovladače nouveau, přidává dalších 60 patchů pro poslední generace CPU.
articles.title: Nvidia poslala 60 patchů do nouveau pro GPU generací Hopper a Blackwell

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Ve stínu vydání Firefoxu 138 přináší Mozilla též beta verzi příštího vydání Firefox 139. Kromě jiných novinek si zde připravili vývojáři vylepšení v podobě rychlejšího HTTP/3 uploadu.
articles.title: Firefox 139 Beta přináší rychlejší HTTP/3 s QUIC 0-RTT

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: Linuxových systémů přibývá, každý den se spouštějí nové servery a někdo se o ně musí starat. To znamená spoustu různých dovedností specifických právě pro linuxové prostředí. Jak to zprovoznit, kudy bezpečně dovnitř, co tam najdeme, jak se o to postaráme a jak to nastavíme nebo rozšíříme.
articles.title: Naučte se používat Linux správně a bezpečně (školení)

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: Fintechová banka Revolut s více než 50 miliony zákazníků po celém světě, oznámila uvedení nových mobilních tarifů Mobile Plans. Měsíční mobilní tarify Revolut nabídnou neomezené hovory, textové zprávy a domácí data, a k tomu 40GB roamingový limit v rámci EU – vše s místním telefonním číslem a bez závazků.
articles.title: Revolut chce konkurovat mobilním operátorům, nabídne neomezený datový tarif za 12,50 eur

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Na bázi Wine 10.x je postaveno budoucí vydání balíku Proton od Valve, jehož beta verze nyní vychází. Mezi hratelné hry s touto verzí Protonu se zařazují ty, jejichž běh byl dosud laděn ve vývojové větvi Proton Experimental. Konkrétně jde o tituly Batman: Arkham Asylum GOTY Edition, Factorio, Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024, No Man's Sky (opraven běh ve VR módu), Rising Storm 2: Vietnam, Sniper Elite: Nazi Zombie Army, X Rebirth VR Edition a další.
articles.title: Valve Proton 10.0 beta opravuje běh řady her

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Společnost Intel odhalila dvojici variant svého dlouho očekávaného výrobního procesu 18A, který má být vhodnější jednak pro výrobu masově prodávaných procesorů a jednak pro výrobu složitých polovodičů složených z více částí.
articles.title: Intel upravil výrobní proces 18A, má variantu pro masovou produkci a 3D čipy pro AI

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Byla vydána verze 138.0 webového prohlížeče Firefox. Přináší podporu otevírání odkazů na panely na pozadí pomocí kontextové nabídky v Linuxu a macOS, vylepšenou funkci automatického vyplňování adres a platebních karet, která si lépe poradí s dynamicky aktualizovanými formuláři, a nové nastavení kontrastu, které uživatelům umožňuje používat stejné barvy na různých webových stránkách pro lepší čitelnost.
articles.title: Firefox 138.0 vylepšuje práci s panely a uživatelskými profily

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Vývojáři distribuce Kali Linux oznámili, že aktualizace softwaru brzy začnou všem uživatelům selhávat. Dojde totiž k výměně klíčů pro podepisování balíčků. Netýká se to jen vás, týká se to všech a je to výhradně naše vina, kají se vývojáři. Ztratili totiž přístup k podpisovému klíči úložiště, takže byli nuceni vytvořit nový.
articles.title: Kali Linux bude měnit klíče, uživatelům selžou aktualizace

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM 2) od Facebook Research je základem, na kterém stojí schopnost nové verze střižny Kdenlive vytvářet masky objektů pro aplikaci efektů či odstranění pozadí. Vše probíhá lokálně na daném PC. Kdenlive 25.04.0 toho ale přináší více, tvůrci dále zapracovali na přesnějším zobrazení zvukových stop v časové ose či přepsání OpentimelineIO pomocí C++.
articles.title: Kdenlive 25.04.0 se segmentací objektů na bázi modelu od Facebooku

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Zdenek Henek)
articles.description: Šesnáctý ročník ne-konference jOpenSpace se koná 3. – 5. října 2025 v Hotelu Antoň v Telči. Pro účast je potřeba vyplnit registrační formulář nolog.link/s/registraceJOS2025.
articles.title: jOpenSpace 2025 registrace

While the volume is impressive, it also signals that the piracy problem is far from being tackled, for now.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Link-Busters Reports its Three Billionth ‘Pirate’ URL to Google Search

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Early April, Belgian media reported new pirate IPTV blocking under a new court obtained by DAZN and 12th Player. Described as "the first of its kind," DNS providers reportedly faced fines of €100,000 per day for non-compliance. Soon after, OpenDNS left Belgium, a replay of its earlier departures from both France and Portugal. Hailed as a “real step forward” against piracy but no mention of a third loss to DNS, the order also contains an apparent secret sauce.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: DAZN’s New Pirate IPTV Blocking Order and its ‘Confidential’ Secret Sauce

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
The Office of the United States Trade Representative has released its annual Special 301 Report, calling out countries that fall short on anti-piracy enforcement and other forms of intellectual property protection. Vietnam is once again one of the key targets and still perceived as a piracy haven, despite the historic takedown of the Fmovies piracy ring last summer.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: US: Vietnam Remains a “Piracy Haven” Despite Fmovies Crackdown

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
The Association of Electronic Communications Operators has provided a very gloomy assessment of progress in the fight against piracy in Portugal. While that may not sound especially unusual, this summer will mark 10 years since the launch of an industry-led, voluntary site-blocking regime, which reportedly reduced visits to pirate sites by 60%+ in a matter of months. Apritel now says that swift financial sanctions are required to being persistent pirate consumers back into line.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Pirate Site Blocks Ineffective? Telcos Call For Sanctions Against Portuguese Users

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Spotify has come a long way since it openly appealed to music pirates in its early days. This week, the streaming giant targeted "SpotifyDL," a browser extension enabling users to download tracks, playlists and albums, by bypassing its protections. Following a DMCA notice filed with GitHub, Spotify successfully forced the developer to strip the tool's core functionality.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Spotify Dismantles ‘SpotifyDL’ Track Download Extension via DMCA Notice

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Used by major video platforms including Netflix, Disney+, Amazon Prime Video, and Hulu to name just a few, Google content protection system Widevine can be found in leading browsers, games consoles, and most mobile devices. Circumvention has been ongoing for years, but after OnlyFans sent a complaint to GitHub, a Widevine decryption project has been ejected from GitHub.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: DRM-Free OnlyFans Downloads See Widevine Project Nuked From GitHub

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
A pending settlement between movie companies and ISP Frontier has significantly altered the scope of an upcoming copyright trial. The movie studios are expected to withdraw their claims, including their demand for pirate site blocking, leaving Frontier to face only major record labels in court. With the music companies seeking potentially over a billion dollars in damages for subscribers' piracy activities, the stakes remain exceptionally high.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Pirate Site Blocking Demands Shelved as Filmmakers Settle With U.S. ISP

articles.description:

From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Top 10 Most Pirated Movies of The Week – 04/28/2025

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
What began this week as research into an abuse of the DMCA to silence this publication, led to an unsettling world where bogus copyright complaints are just the tip of the iceberg. Waves of takedown notices, many filed by members of the public and various businesses, shine an unflattering light on the human condition. Whether hiding the truth, gagging rivals and critics, or simply telling tales; takedown notices sent by the public put us all at risk.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: DMCA Notices Can Silence Critics But Complaints By The Public Put All at Risk

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Technically speaking, any modern web browser can stream pirated movies and TV shows, but some make it easier than others. The Seekee app, available on iOS and indirectly on Android, markets itself as a browser with AI capabilities and fast video streaming. The latter stands out, as pirated content is surprisingly easy to find and is organized for optimal viewing pleasure. But at what cost? 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Seekee Browser App is a Magnet for Movie, TV Show, and Anime Pirates

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
A new report offers a rare glimpse into the world of pirate CDNs. The report suggests that the largest players in Russia together service around 1,400 third party pirate sites, whose operators draw on massive libraries of pirated content offered by the CDNs.  A single CDN reportedly controls around 60% of the Russian market, using CDN infrastructure in the Netherlands, the United States, Ukraine, Germany, and France.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Pirate CDNs Fueling 1,400 Russian Sites “Use EU & US CDN Infrastructure”

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Twenty years ago, the statement "You Wouldn't Steal a Car" launched one of the most iconic anti-piracy campaigns. Through a memorable commercial, the movie industry forcefully equated digital piracy with physical theft. While the PSA became instantly recognizable, spawning countless parodies, it also attracted its own controversy. New revelations suggest that the campaign's distinctive font may have itself been copied, or dare we say 'stolen'.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: “You Wouldn’t Steal a Car”… But Would You Pirate a Font?

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Since October 2023, relentless high-profile media reports have warned that UK-based users of pirate streaming services run a serious risk of arrest. Those claims sit in contrast to comments made by the head of the Police Intellectual Property Crime Unit (PIPCU) in a recent interview. Detective Chief Inspector Emma Warbey concedes that people who use pirate devices are largely able to do so "without risk of arrest." That doesn't mean entirely without risk, however.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Pirate IPTV Users Largely Face No Risk of Arrest, UK’s Top Piracy Cop Concedes

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
The MPA and RIAA want to have their say in a crucial third-party Ninth Circuit appeal about the use of DMCA subpoenas against alleged online pirates. Fearing a ruling that could limit their enforcement options, the groups requested speaking time at an upcoming hearing. This intervention, as well as previous commentary from the EFF, which is backed by a new party, underscores the high-stakes nature of the case.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: MPA and RIAA Want to be Heard in Crucial DMCA Subpoena Appeal

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:

From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Vercel Slams LaLiga Piracy Blocks as “Unaccountable Internet Censorship”

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:

The game giant seeks $17,500 in damages for copyright infringement, including streaming pre-release games and sharing links to emulators. In addition, Nintendo requests a broad global injunction to prevent future infringements, even for games that do not yet exist.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Nintendo Seeks Damages & Broad Injunction Against ‘Pirate’ Game Streamer

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
New research published in the Journal of Cultural Economics documents how the COVID-19 pandemic created a surge in "new pirates". Contrary to simple narratives, increased online piracy during the pandemic isn't always associated with less legal consumption. In fact, the relationship between piracy and legal markets is far from straightforward.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: The Piracy Pandemic: COVID-19 Led to a Surge of New Pirates

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Since it's launch in 2017, the Alliance for Entertainment and Creativity has established itself as the most powerful coalition of its type on the planet. In the first three months of 2025, ACE welcomed new members to its ranks but reported just two successful outcomes concerning online enforcement operations. ACE has a track record of underreporting progress, the first quarter of 2025 was no exception.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: ACE & MPA Quietly Seized Dozens of Pirate Domains in Q1 2025

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Reddit's latest transparency report reveals a notable reversal in copyright takedown trends. After years of increases, the platform removed just over 550,000 items last year due to copyright complaints, down sharply from roughly 1.2 million removed in 2023. Notably, Reddit keeps an eye on potential overreach; it declined to remove an AI-generated sports parody, deeming it transformative fair use.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Reddit’s Copyright Removals Drop to Multi-Year Low

articles.description: April 1st has come and gone, but have no fear, for beta2 is here. We’ve fixed a bunch more since beta1, and need more testing. Also, we added some new features! Highlights include: Snow-covered rocks are now visible Steep hills from map generation or heightmap import now get extra rocks Houses can be individually placed by players in the scenario editor and (if enabled) in-game, and can be protected from replacement during town growth Touchpad two-finger map scrolling for Windows NewGRF Badges A variety of bugfixes (As always, see the changelog for further details). What are badges, you ask? Badges are something add-on (NewGRF) authors can put on their content to help you find e.g. the vehicle or station you want to use. For example, various vehicle add-ons use a mix of different icons, overlay images or texts to indicate the power source or the suggested usage of a vehicle. With badges, this information can be represented in a clear way including built-in filtering, that is cohesive between different add-ons. As this beta is the first release featuring badge support, there aren’t many updated add-ons yet, but we’re excited to see what authors do with the new feature. articles.description:
Cory Snider discovered that Docker incorrectly handled networking packet
encapsulation. An attacker could use this issue to inject internet
packets in established connection, possibly causing a denial of service or
bypassing firewall protections. This issue only affected Ubuntu 22.04 LTS,
Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, and Ubuntu 18.04 LTS. (CVE-2023-28840, CVE-2023-28841,
CVE-2023-28842)

Rory McNamara discovered that Docker incorrectly handled cache in the
BuildKit toolkit. An attacker could possibly use this issue to expose
sensitive information. (CVE-2024-23651)

It was discovered that Docker incorrectly handled parallel operations in
some circumstances, which could possibly lead to undefined behavior.
(CVE-2024-36621, CVE-2024-36623)

Rory McNamara discovered that Docker incorrectly verified file paths during
a certain command in the BuildKit toolkit. An attacker could possibly use
this issue to delete arbitrary files from the system. (CVE-2024-23652)
articles.title: USN-7474-1: Docker vulnerabilities

articles.description:
Junwha Hong and Wonil Jang discovered that Micropython incorrectly handled
the length of a buffer in mp_vfs_umount, leading to a heap-based buffer 
overflow vulnerability. If a user or automated system were tricked into
opening a specially crafted file, an attacker could possibly use this issue
to cause a denial of service or possibly execute arbitrary code.
(CVE-2024-8946)


Junwha Hong and Wonil Jang discovered that Micropython incorrectly handled
memory, leading to a use-after-free vulnerability under certain 
circumstances. If a user or automated system were tricked into opening a 
specially crafted file, an attacker could possibly use this issue to
cause a denial of service or possibly execute arbitrary code. 
(CVE-2024-8947)

It was discovered that Middleware USB Host MCU Component incorrectly
handled memory, leading to a buffer overflow vulnerability, If a user or 
automated system were tricked into opening a specially crafted file, an 
attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service or
possibly execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2021-42553)
articles.title: USN-7472-1: Micropython vulnerabilities

articles.description:
It was discovered that Ghostscript incorrectly handled parsing certain PS
files. An attacker could use this issue to cause Ghostscript to crash,
resulting in a denial of service, or possibly bypass file path validation.
articles.title: USN-7473-1: Ghostscript vulnerability

USN-7315-1 fixed a vulnerability in PostgreSQL. This update provides the
corresponding update for Ubuntu 18.04 LTS.

Original advisory details:

 Stephen Fewer discovered that PostgreSQL incorrectly handled quoting
 syntax in certain scenarios. A remote attacker could possibly use this
 issue to perform SQL injection attacks.
articles.title: USN-7315-2: PostgreSQL vulnerability

articles.description:
USN-7469-1 fixed a vulnerability in Apache Traffic Server. This update
provides the corresponding updates for H2O.

Original advisory details:

 It was discovered that Apache Traffic Server exhibited poor server
 resource management in its HTTP/2 protocol. An attacker could possibly
 use this issue to cause Apache Traffic Server to crash, resulting in
 a denial of service.
articles.title: USN-7469-4: H2O vulnerability

articles.description:
It was discovered that poppler did not properly verify adbe.pkcs7.sha1
signatures in PDF documents. An attacker could possibly use this issue
to create documents with forged signatures that are treated as
legitimately signed.
articles.title: USN-7471-1: poppler vulnerabilities

articles.description:
USN-7423-1 fixed several vulnerabilities in GNU. This update provides
the corresponding update for Ubuntu 16.04 LTS and Ubuntu 18.04 LTS.

Original advisory details:

 It was discovered that GNU binutils incorrectly handled certain inputs.
 An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a crash or execute
 arbitrary code. (CVE-2025-0840)

 It was discovered that GNU binutils incorrectly handled certain inputs.
 An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a crash, expose
 sensitive information or execute arbitrary code.
 (CVE-2025-1153)

 It was discovered that ld in GNU binutils incorrectly handled certain
 files. An attacker could possibly use this issue to execute arbitrary
 code. (CVE-2025-1176)
articles.title: USN-7423-2: GNU binutils vulnerabilities
